facts.text: I want a system that uses users' opinions to do cryptocurrency trading named All2Trade.
I want the application to be built with Python 3.
I want the application to use Flask.
I want the application to use MySQL.
I want the purpose of the application to be making money using condensed knowledge of the users base.
I want the users of the application to be everyone who wants to help the system make the right decision and wants a portion of the revenues.
I want the system to be completely automated and minimal.
I want users to provide opinions about the future trend of the currency they want through a simple interface.
I want the platform to be completely free for users.
I want the business to generate revenue by trading using users' opinions.
I want to pay users a small percentage of the payout.
I want to take the difference between the payout percentage and the trade revenue.
I want to expand the architecture by adding a deep learning system that learns and evolves over time.
I want the deep learning system to add its opinion to improve the overall goodness of the choices made automatically by the system.
I want a database structure for the application.

keyphrases: model learns and evolves over time
